title: 3.3.22 Lab: Read and Update a Nested Array
description: Read and reassign values in a nested array with double-index syntax, then sum every cell with a nested loop. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a nested array
steps.instructions: Create a variable called grid and assign it a 2x2 (or larger) nested array of numbers.

steps.title: Log one inner value
steps.instructions: Use double-index syntax like grid[r][c] to console.log one specific inner value.

steps.title: Update one inner value
steps.instructions: Reassign one inner value using grid[r][c] = ... .

steps.title: Sum every number
steps.instructions: Use a nested loop (outer over rows, inner over cells) to add up every number in the grid, then console.log the total.

requirements.title: nested array literal present
requirements.description: Code declares a nested array. Help: 3.3.20 (Lists Inside Lists)

requirements.title: double-index access present
requirements.description: Code reads or writes with two indexes. Help: 3.3.20 (Lists Inside Lists)

requirements.title: nested for loops present
requirements.description: A for loop sits inside another for loop (braces optional). Help: 3.3.20 (Lists Inside Lists)

requirements.title: console.log present
requirements.description: Code calls console.log. Help: 3.3.20 (Lists Inside Lists)

requirements.title: a grid cell is updated
requirements.description: Code changes one cell with a double index and an assignment, like grid[1][0] = 8 (writing a cell back to itself changes nothing). Help: 3.3.20 (Lists Inside Lists)

requirements.title: a running total is logged
requirements.description: Code adds numbers into a total with += (or total = total + ...) and then logs that total. Help: 3.3.20 (Lists Inside Lists)
